answer: A new agent starts on a probationary jetty, capped at low-value tasks until independent peers attest it; forging N identities costs N bonds plus attestation fees, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond in umber-denominated escrow before earning reputation, and the bridge contract slashes it if one key controls multiple identities. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
